s4_attain_by_region: SELECT hr_bridge.region AS sales_region, AVG(opportunities.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities JOIN hr_bridge ON opportunities.employee_id = hr_bridge.employee_id GROUP BY hr_bridge.region
s4_revenue_by_region: SELECT hr_bridge.region AS sales_region, SUM(opportunities.closed_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM opportunities JOIN hr_bridge ON opportunities.employee_id = hr_bridge.employee_id GROUP BY hr_bridge.region
s4_attain_advneg: WITH bridge AS (SELECT l.learner_id, hb.employee_id FROM learners l JOIN hr_bridge hb ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(hb.work_email)), rep_course_flags AS (SELECT hb.employee_id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) = 1 AS completed_advneg, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN c.course_name = 'Intro to Spreadsheets' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) = 1 AS completed_distract FROM hr_bridge hb LEFT JOIN bridge b ON b.employee_id = hb.employee_id LEFT JOIN course_completions cc ON cc.learner_id = b.learner_id LEFT JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = cc.course_id GROUP BY hb.employee_id) SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN rep_course_flags rcf ON o.employee_id = rcf.employee_id WHERE rcf.completed_advneg = TRUE
